bio.text: Linda B. Rosenthal represents Assembly District 67 in Manhattan, which includes the Upper West Side and parts of Clinton/Hell's Kitchen.
She was first elected in 2006, after 13 years as Manhattan District Director and Director of Special Projects for U.S. Rep. Jerrold Nadler.
She has a B.A. in history from the University of Rochester and is a lifelong Upper West Side resident, according to her official biography.
